title: Disguised mini-bosses: chest Mimics, the Nymph, the Wyvern
player_outcome: Surprise moments like Terraria: some chests underground are Mimics that wake when you open or hit them and hop after you; the Nymph poses as a lost girl until approached; Wyverns sweep the sky islands as long segmented dragons with a real sky presence.
design: Mimic: a chest-like tile object/NPC disguise state (looks like a chest, opening it triggers the mimic) placed by worldgen/treasure pass at a low rate; Nymph disguise as a town-like NPC until close; Wyvern uses the worm/segment framework with flight; loot per Terraria.
Quality bar: what a AAA, realistic 3D Terraria made by Re-Logic would ship. Data-driven, performance-budgeted by graphics preset, Core logic tested, follows docs/overhaul/_BRIEF.md (LEAN MODE).
verification: creatures.cmds disguised mimic wakes on open
